JOURNEY.SEND_DESC: Send an enquiry and track replies

STATUS_HELP.SUBMITTED: The facility will review your needs and reply. You can cancel if you no longer need a consultation.
STATUS_HELP.IN_REVIEW: The facility is reviewing your needs and schedule availability.
STATUS_HELP.SCHEDULE_PROPOSED: Review the proposed time and facility message before accepting.
STATUS_HELP.CONFIRMED: The time is agreed. Staff can mark it complete only after the consultation time.
STATUS_HELP.DECLINED: This request is closed. Review the reason in the history and find another facility if needed.
STATUS_HELP.CANCELLED: The cancelled request remains in your history. Create a new request for a new enquiry.
STATUS_HELP.COMPLETED: The consultation is complete. You can review the details and history below.

STATUS_HELP_STAFF.SUBMITTED: New request. Start the review to read the needs and arrange a consultation time.
STATUS_HELP_STAFF.IN_REVIEW: Confirm the preferred time, propose another time, or decline with a reason.
STATUS_HELP_STAFF.SCHEDULE_PROPOSED: Waiting for the family to accept the proposed time. You can revise the proposal if needed.
STATUS_HELP_STAFF.CONFIRMED: The time is agreed. Mark it complete only after the consultation time.
STATUS_HELP_STAFF.DECLINED: This request is closed; the decline reason is kept in the history.
STATUS_HELP_STAFF.CANCELLED: This request was cancelled and remains in the history.
STATUS_HELP_STAFF.COMPLETED: The consultation is complete. Details and history are kept for reference.

ACTION_HELP.START_REVIEW: Move this request to under review and record the action in its history.
ACTION_HELP.CONFIRM_PREFERRED: Check the facility’s availability before confirming the following time.
ACTION_HELP.PROPOSE_SCHEDULE: Choose a future time and add a message so the family can decide.
ACTION_HELP.ACCEPT_SCHEDULE: Do you agree to the following consultation time? This confirms the schedule for both parties.
ACTION_HELP.DECLINE: Explain the reason to the family. This closes the request.
ACTION_HELP.CANCEL: Give a cancellation reason. A cancelled request cannot be resumed; a new request can be created.
ACTION_HELP.COMPLETE: Mark complete only once the consultation has taken place. The action is recorded in the history.

SAMPLE.NEEDS: Our family would like to explore care for Mr An, particularly daily living support and social activities. Please advise on admission requirements and costs.
SAMPLE.PROPOSAL: We suggest an afternoon consultation so the assigned staff member can join. Please review and confirm if the time works for your family.
SAMPLE.CANCELLATION: The family changed its consultation plans.
SAMPLE.DECLINED: The facility cannot meet this need at the requested time.

ERROR.ACTION: This action is no longer available for the current status or permissions.

ERROR.CONTACT_PHONE: Enter a valid facility phone number, or leave it blank if not published.

ERROR.FORBIDDEN: Your account is not permitted to perform this action.
